0.q: Both 1028-1-ORF3 and 1028-9-ORF2 were assumed to be Na+/H+ antiporter NhaC family proteins... two sequences showed 100% similarity to the published gene sequences BB347_08225 and BB347_08285, respectively.

1.q: KNabc/nhaC1 could grow up to the presence of 0.6 M NaCl or 30 mM LiCl... NhaC1 exhibited Na+(K+, Li+)/H+ antiport activity when pH ranged from 7.0 to 10.0, with optimal antiport activities at pH 9.5.

2.q: KNabc/nhaC2 could grow up to the presence of 0.7 M NaCl or 40 mM LiCl... NhaC2 also exhibited Na+(K+, Li+)/H+ antiport activity when pH ranged from 7.0 to 10.0.
